study type: Prospective cohort study with a cross-sectional comparison at delivery.
cohort: The study included 75 healthy pregnant women and 37 women with preeclampsia for delivery samples, and a longitudinal cohort of 70 healthy pregnant women and 35 women with preeclampsia.
finding: The study found elevated maternal adhesion molecule levels (VCAM1, ICAM1) before the onset of preeclampsia, and at delivery, adhesion molecules were elevated in maternal circulation but lower in fetal circulation in preeclampsia cases, with no indication of placental release to the mother.
cross-section timing: At delivery, and at gestational weeks 14-16, 22-24, and 30-32 for longitudinal measurements.
